description: This file defines the DateTimeField class used for handling date and time operations within the vtiger CRM system, including formatting, timezone conversions, and database interactions.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class for managing date and time formatting, timezone conversions, and database compatibility within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: getDBInsertDateValue
methods.description: Returns the date part of the datetime in database format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: getDBInsertDateTimeValue
methods.description: Returns the combined date and time in database format.

methods.name: getDisplayDateTimeValue
methods.description: Returns the datetime in display format for the user.

methods.name: convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Converts a date string to database format based on user preferences.

methods.name: __convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Internal method to convert date string to database format based on specified format.

methods.name: convertToInternalFormat
methods.description: Converts a date string into an array of date and time components.

methods.name: convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Converts a date string to user-preferred display format.

methods.name: __convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Internal method to convert date components to user format.

methods.name: convertToUserTimeZone
methods.description: Converts a datetime value from database timezone to user's timezone.

methods.name: convertToDBTimeZone
methods.description: Converts a datetime value from user's timezone to database timezone.

methods.name: convertTimeZone
methods.description: Converts time between different time zones.

methods.name: getDBInsertTimeValue
methods.description: Returns the time part of the datetime in database format (HH:MM:SS).

methods.name: getDisplayDate
methods.description: Returns the date in user display format.

methods.name: getDisplayTime
methods.description: Returns the time in user display format.

methods.name: getPHPDateFormat
methods.description: Returns PHP date format string based on user preference.

methods.name: sanitizeDate
methods.description: Sanitizes date string based on user date format.
